_note: SYNTHETIC example fund. Not any real fund, LPA, or administrator's data. Terms are simplified for illustration.
management_fee_basis: commitment, charged quarterly (one quarter = rate / 4), allocated to each LP on its own commitment
fee_offset_basis: portfolio fees received by the manager reduce that quarter's management fee, shared by commitment
equalization_interest_basis: simple interest, actual/365, from each earlier call date to the later close date; paid by the later-close LP on top of its commitment and credited to earlier LPs by commitment
allocation_basis: expenses and unrealized gains or losses are allocated by commitment among LPs admitted at the allocation date
